correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=4, the graph has explicit 4n edges and a 3-color equality-penalty energy. Mycielski chromaticity plus an explicit coloring determines the exact minimum (0 for even n, J for odd n). Summing clone spins gives an exact nine-state cyclic transfer Z_n(t)=3 tr(T(t)^n). Exact integer characteristic and polynomial matrix identities derive the even cubic-root sum and the odd first-defect recurrence for all n, including initial traces and a generating function. Positive distinct roots and the nonzero dominant odd residue give the shared entropy rate. Embedded integer-arithmetic verifier and separate C++ exhaustive enumerator replayed the n=4,5,6,7 counts, respectively, 78,660,228,3192; finite enumeration is corroboration rather than the infinite proof. Boundary conditions n>=4 and J>0 explicitly maintained.

value.rationale: The parity-dependent minimum-energy color-configuration count is a physically meaningful low-temperature residual entropy invariant of an intrinsic infinite family of sparse frustrated graphs. The Mycielski chromatic obstruction produces a qualitative even/odd difference, but the nontrivial cubic recurrence, extra linear factor for odd cycles, and shared exact exponential growth cannot be read off from chromatic numbers. The result distinguishes single-bond frustration from the exponential multiplicity of microscopic realizations and supports finite-cluster benchmarks without pretending to find a thermodynamic transition.
